Цена покупки — за сколько ты сразу купиш: The buy price is what you pay to buy the product instantly on the Bazaar (the cheapest sell order). The sell price is what you get selling instantly (the highest buy order). The difference between them is the spread: flippers profit from it by placing orders.
Свеча показывает цену за период: открыти: A candle shows the price over a period: open, high, low and close. Green means the price rose over the period, red means it fell.
Hypixel отдаёт только текущие цены, поэт: Hypixel provides only current prices, so the site collects the history itself: prices are recorded every 20 seconds. Minute candles are kept for 3 days, five-minute ones for a month, hourly for a year, daily for all time. The most traded products are backfilled with the previous month.
Объём — оценка по недельным счётчикам Hy: Volume is an estimate from Hypixel's weekly counters: the game doesn't show individual trades, so it's an approximate number of items bought and sold.
Управление: колесо мыши или щипок двумя: Controls: mouse wheel or pinch — zoom, drag — scroll, drag the price scale — stretch vertically, double-click the scale — reset. Esc cancels drawing and exits full screen.
Время на графике — твоё местное. Дневные: Time on the chart is your local time. Daily, weekly and monthly candles start at midnight UTC.
Lowest BIN — самый дешёвый лот «Buy It N: Lowest BIN is the cheapest Buy It Now listing on the Auction House: the price to buy the item right away. The site scans the whole auction house every 3 minutes.
Продажи — цены, по которым предмет на са: Sales are the prices the item actually sold for (BIN listings only, bid auctions are not counted). Volume on the chart is the real number of items sold.
Самый дешёвый лот обычно «голый»: без ча: The cheapest listing is usually a bare item: no enchants, reforge or upgrades. Armor, weapons and pets have separate prices per variant: stars, Recombobulator, pet rarity.
Подробная история аукциона хранится 30 д: Detailed auction history is kept for 30 days, daily candles for longer. The smallest candle is 5 minutes.
